candidates.name: Endophthalmitis
support_spans: 4 days of blurry vision and pain in her left eye
conjunctival hyperemia, faint keratic precipitates, 3+ cells with fibrin in the anterior chamber
development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination findings, including blurry vision, eye pain, and signs of inflammation in the anterior chamber, are consistent with endophthalmitis, a severe infection of the eye.

candidates.name: Streptococcal endophthalmitis
support_spans: Gram stain revealed gram-positive cocci in chains
Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius
candidates.why: The gram-positive cocci in chains and the culture result of Streptococcus intermedius support the diagnosis of Streptococcal endophthalmitis.

candidates.name: Iris abscess
support_spans: a whitish focal granuloma at the 4-o'clock position at the pupillary margin
development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
candidates.why: The presence of a whitish focal granuloma at the pupillary margin and the development of hypopyon and fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion are consistent with an iris abscess.

candidates.name: Lens-induced glaucoma
support_spans: mild nuclear sclerosis
contradict_spans: Intraocular pressures were 15 mm Hg OD and 11 mm Hg OS
candidates.why: The presence of mild nuclear sclerosis could suggest a possible diagnosis of lens-induced glaucoma, but the normal intraocular pressures make this less likely.

unexplained_specific_evidence: Intraocular pressures were 15 mm Hg OD and 11 mm Hg OS

selector.rationale: Blurry vision, pain, conjunctival hyperemia, and development of hypopyon with fibrinous material are strongly supportive of Endophthalmitis, which is further confirmed by the presence of gram-positive cocci and rods in the Gram stain and the culture of Streptococcus intermedius.

rejected.label: Lens-induced glaucoma
rejected.why: Normal intraocular pressures contradict the diagnosis of glaucoma.
